images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5 cinematic deep-sea adventure inside a bioluminescent ocean cave. An attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat; natural balanced sturdy build; bright warm orange short coat with realistic darker tabby stripes; clean white fur on muzzle and chin continuing naturally through neck, chest and belly; all four paws clean white from toes upward; a distinctive congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around the mouth resembling a curry stain, explicitly not food or dirt; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. As a deep-sea relic diver inside a safe transparent observation suit, the cat shows tongue-out blep and both paws pressed against glass, paw pads visibly flattened naturally. A clockwork time machine reverses falling shells, bubbles, and harmless debris in a clear practical-effect spiral. A tiny winged cicada-cat prop clings to a branch with a real cicada perched above its head. Behind the luminous cave, a whale-sized harmless shadow crosses the water; a distant eclipse masquerade has masks becoming transparent. Camera distance three meters, side profile viewpoint through curved glass, 70mm lens, medium depth of field, blue bioluminescent key light with narrow silver beams, realistic refraction, bubbles, glass contact, fur, whiskers, and suit reflections. Safe tank photography and compositing, no drowning or distress. Correct feline anatomy, no duplicate cats, no extra limbs, no human features, no cartoon, illustration, 3D render, plastic fur, logos, text, watermark, UI, captions, or readable title.
